Nadia (PM): quick run: we need to rebaseline the 10/01 milestone. Two conflicting asks: (A) include multi-tenant embeddings cache in MVP (customer-driven) vs (B) ship MVP without cache and offer a paid Early-Access Embeds Tier after launch. Tradeoffs: schedule slip vs revenue/sentiment. We have a 48h window to lock the cutlist. thoughts?
Ike (Eng): infra reality: multi-tenant cache touches KV routing, eviction policy, and the hot-shard optimizer. Fixing safely is ~12 dev days + infra validation. We could implement an Early-Access Tier on dedicated hosts in ~6 dev days with gating logic.
Pri (ML): quality note: cache -> +9% recall on long queries and reduces tail latency. Early-Access Tier gives near-cache quality for paying customers; non-cached GA will show measurable drop on enterprise evals.
Vera (FinOps): cost angle: global non-cached approach increases per-query cost by ~2.8x at 1M queries/day; Early-Access can be billed to offset costs but requires billing + quota plumbing. We can absorb pilot costs for strategic partners if product team approves.
Sam (CS): customer feedback: two partners (NashCorp, Beacon) insist on cache for pilot. They might sign if we offer an invite-only Early-Access Tier with clear quotas and an SLA. Others are ok with GA non-cached as long as we document limits.
Nadia (PM): framing options: 1) Delay GA by ~2+ weeks to include full multi-tenant cache, 2) Ship on-time GA w/out cache + offer invite-only Early-Access Tier (paid) for partners, 3) Ship on-time GA w/out cache and promise cache in v1 with no early access. Which balances product risk, revenue, and launch velocity?
Ike (Eng): 2 gives the best risk isolation. Dedicated hosts for Early-Access prevent KV routing changes in GA and give time to stabilize. We'll need feature flags, quota enforcement, and billing hooks (~6 dev days).
Pri (ML): 2 is preferred. I'll add continuous recall probes and a pilot acceptance checklist (recall >= X% and P95 latency <= Y ms).
Vera (FinOps): 2 is OK if billing and quota can be MVP-light (manual invoice + quota flag). Fully automated billing is later. Approve absorbing initial infra cost for strategic partners.
Sam (CS): 2 is fine. Need a documented onboarding playbook, a rollback plan, and a comms template. I'll prepare and coordinate next-step calls with partners.
Nadia (PM): quick vote: 1=delay GA for full cache, 2=ship GA + Early-Access Tier, 3=ship GA + promise v1 cache later
Ike (Eng): 2
Pri (ML): 2
Vera (FinOps): 2
Sam (CS): 2
Nadia (PM): consensus = 2. Decision note: rebaseline: keep GA target, exclude full multi-tenant embeddings cache from MVP, and implement an invite-only Early-Access Embeds Tier on dedicated infra for strategic partners. Requirements: feature-flagged pilot, quota enforcement, pilot acceptance criteria, billing or manual invoicing, onboarding playbook, and rollback kill-switch.
deploy-bot: created feature-flag rollout/embeds.early_access (staged=false)
Ike (Eng): opened ticket INFRA-9011 to provision dedicated early-access hosts + emergency kill-switch; PR for feature flag WIP.
Pri (ML): adding CI eval job (embeds-early-access-check) and dashboard tile; will publish acceptance thresholds in the pilot doc.
Vera (FinOps): I'll draft billing note: manual invoice + usage cap for pilot; need product sign-off.
Sam (CS): drafting onboarding checklist and comms; will send intro email template for NashCorp/Beacon after product ok.
Nadia (PM): I'll update the release board and milestone tracker: "Cut: MVP excludes multi-tenant embeddings cache; offer invite-only Early-Access Embeds Tier on dedicated infra for strategic customers; defer multi-tenant cache to v1. Launch criteria updated to include pilot acceptance pass and rollback plan." Tagging @launch-team and leaving accountability: Ike (eng infra), Pri (ML eval), Vera (billing), Sam (onboarding). Keep updates here. :white_check_mark:
